UNION PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION
EXAMINATION SCHEDULE / TIME TABLE
CIVIL SERVICES (PRELIMINARY) EXAMINATION, 2026

The Union Public Service Commission will conduct the Civil Services (Preliminary) Examination, 2026 on 24.05.2026 across various examination centres all over India in two sessions:
Forenoon Session (09:30 AM to 11:30 AM): General Studies Paper-I
Afternoon Session (02:30 PM to 04:30 PM): General Studies Paper-II (CSAT)
Candidates are advised to take note of the schedule.
